raja: Quick report from orca14b onboarding. With the new int3 packing (experimental) we see reproducible context corruption only when: tiled prefetch + compact rotate + alternating anchors > 6k tokens.

raja: repro command I used:```bash
./bin/prefill_check --model orca14b --quant int3 --prefetch tiled --rotate compact --prompt tests/alternating_anchors.txt --max-tokens 8192 --seed 42
```

marta: int3? that's fresh. Did you confirm it's not a tokenizer mismatch (RoPE base)?

raja: checked tokenizer positions vs runtime mapping with the map-debug tool; positions align. Disabling KV cache removes the corruption so it's KV-path.

niko: can you paste the shortest failing input and the deviation? small examples help.

raja: failing seed uses pattern: "A:{4000 x 'alpha'} B:{4000 x 'beta'} Q: summarize". With KV on, summary sometimes swaps adjectives (e.g., says 'beta' for section A). With KV off, perfect.

qa-bot: perf-smoke queued: 6 runs across x86/arm. Expected runtime ~18m.

raja: trimmed logs:```
[2026-01-12T02:11:05Z] prefill: anchors=2 tokens=8000
[2026-01-12T02:11:05Z] prefetch: mode=tiled stride=16 tile_bytes=2048 pad=8
[2026-01-12T02:11:05Z] kv: write start=4000 end=8000
[2026-01-12T02:11:06Z] generate: attn_offset=4000
[2026-01-12T02:11:06Z] WARN: rop_delta=0.00048828125
[2026-01-12T02:11:06Z] ERROR: kv_map_mismatch: expected_idx=4799 actual_idx=4787
```

marta: rop_delta again. Could be off-by-pad in tiled bytes -> token index back-conversion. int3 packing has 3 bits per token, padding to 8-byte lanes will cause fractional tokens if math not careful.

niko: we recently merged a micro-opt to compute tile_offset in bytes then divide by token_byte_size: that invites truncation if pad != multiple. Did your run use the new memcpy branch?

raja: yes, the runtime selected memcpy_packed_v2 (fast path). I re-ran with memcpy_packed_v1 and mismatch disappeared. So memcpy variant + tile math is suspect.

marta: can you show the compute snippet?

raja: pasted (simplified):```c
int compute_tile_index(int base_token, int stride, int tile_idx, int token_bytes, int pad) {
    int bytes_per_token = token_bytes; // for int3 we coalesce into 3bits streams
    int tile_bytes = stride * bytes_per_token + pad; // pad may be nonzero for packing
    int absolute_byte = base_token * bytes_per_token + tile_idx * tile_bytes;
    return absolute_byte / bytes_per_token; // truncation here
}
```

niko: yep that's the issue. If pad non-multiple-of-token_bytes, division truncates fraction, shifting indices. For int3 token_bytes is fractional conceptually; our implementation maps 3bits->packed lanes which breaks integer algebra.

marta: mitigation options: 1) do all math in bit-units and preserve exactness, 2) assert (absolute_byte % bytes_per_token)==0 before division, 3) maintain token-index-only code path that accounts for pad by redistributing it.

raja: quick proposal: add unit tests for packed quantizations that validate tile index invertibility and add an assertion in the tiled prefetch path for the next patch to catch this early. Also add an integration regression (alternating_anchors) to nightly-harness for orca14b-int3.

infra-bot: Created nightly job orca14b-int3-prefill at 04:00 UTC (run=smoke, owner=eng-ml).

niko: I'll prepare a small patch to compute in bitspace: multiply tokens->bits first, do adds, then divide by bits-per-token (3) to get exact token index. That should avoid truncation.

marta: note: we should also check rotate math for fractional rop_scale effects  if we use float multiply to compute rotary offsets we might accumulate tiny deltas across long anchors. Add a compare-run that toggles rotate-mode legacy vs compact as well.

raja: done: added toggles to regression. Also uploading failing seeds and diffs to the issue tracker and will link PR once ready.

niko: will run cross-arch reproducer after patch. Ping me @niko when PR is ready.

raja: thanks. Will open PR with tests + assert. :rocket:
